notes: Your whole story is kept now. Older messages used to disappear once the story summary was written; now you can scroll all the way back (Show earlier messages).
Hover or tap any message for tools: ✏️ edit it, 📍 pin it to your timeline, ⤺ rewind the story to it, or ⑂ branch a new timeline from it.
Rewinding also rewinds the world: the clock, where you are, who's with you, trust, moods, outfits and phone contacts go back to how they were.
↻ Regenerate keeps the old reply: flip between versions with ◀ ▶. It also rewinds the world before trying again.
Alternate timelines: branch from any message to try a different choice; your original story stays untouched. Timelines show up with your 1-on-1 chats.
"Previously…" recap when you come back to a story after a while.
📅 Events → Timeline: pinned moments, big memories and relationship changes.
